text:
Mara - Growth Marketing: Quick kickoff for a compact community launch: RefGuide Tiny (OSS refapp + 2 micro-tutorials). Need blog post, tiny benchmark blurb, webinar, gated LP with lead routing, and 6 social variants. Who owns what?
Ike - DevRel: I can do the tutorials + 2min demo. I'll run a small perf pass (local vs hosted vs quantized). Will keep bench bullets short and non-comparative.
Tara - Content: I'll write the blog and social drafts. Tone: engineer-first, direct. Two headline ideas: 'RefGuide Tiny: build an LLM feature in under an hour' or 'Tiny starter for local-to-cloud LLM dev'. Leaning to the first.
Lena - Design: I'll make a compact hero, a 3-bar benchmark graphic, and a 6s GIF. Need final copy by Thu 11am to lock assets.
Owen - GrowthOps: Webinar suggestion: Tue Apr 19, 10am PT. Landing form: name, email, role, company_size, use-case. Zap -> HubSpot webhook. Routing rule: company_size>120 -> AE queue, else nurture. Also add property refguide_tiny=true.
Mara - Growth Marketing: Ike, can you give two-line benchmark bullets for the blog: median & p95, and a single-line cost delta? Keep numbers rounded and add caveat.
Ike - DevRel: Draft bullets: local median ~88ms, local p95 ~310ms; hosted median ~125ms, hosted p95 ~420ms. Quantized setup ~2.9x lower per-token cost. Will add: 'Measured on our harness; results may vary.'
Tara - Content: Draft social (X):
"RefGuide Tiny — an OSS starter to build & tune LLM features locally + in the cloud. Hands-on guide, reproducible benchmarks, and a live demo Apr 19. https://redwood.ai/refguide-tiny #oss #llm"
artifacts-bot: Artifact published: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/refguide-tiny/v0.1/refguide-tiny.tar.gz
Lena - Design: Posting hero and benchmark PNG in #design-review now. Please quick-approve.
Owen - GrowthOps: I'll create LP and test the Zap; will share link for review. Once registrants >40 I'll post calendar invite.
Mara - Growth Marketing: Owners recap: Ike (tutorial + bench blurbs), Tara (blog + socials), Lena (assets), Owen (webinar + routing). Target publish + webinar on Apr 19 AM. I'll assemble the checklist and folder path in the channel tomorrow. :rocket:
